Subject: Update on Your Application for the Marketing Position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the marketing position at [Company Name] and for sharing your background with us. We truly appreciate the effort you put into your application.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely aligns with the specific needs of this role at this time. Please know that this decision was not a reflection of your skills or potential, as we were impressed by your qualifications.

We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers page for future opportunities that may be a better match for your expertise. We wish you all the best in your job search and professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Company Name]
